subject: CONTRACT TGP2 private (TLS) + workgroup (WLS) memory: header words 17/18 + per-dispatch LOCAL_STORAGE (compute owns pipeline_format.h + bridge)
body:
Finding: observed SpringBoard D8F18H kUseSoftwareLinearFilter=1 refuses because a dynamically indexed Private uint[8] lands in Mesa scratch => TLS (NOT threadgroup memory; no Workgroup vars/barriers in that module). Separately TGP2 never lowered Workgroup variables (any shared+barrier kernel refused 'unlowered pointer'). I am implementing both in mali_compute_compiler.c v2 (panvk order: nir_lower_vars_to_explicit_types(nir_var_mem_shared, panvk shared_type_info) + nir_lower_explicit_io(shared, 32bit_offset), zero-init when requested; Bifrost emits shared LOAD/STORE/ATOM/BARRIER; scratch/spills use TLS).
REQUEST compute (owner pipeline_format.h), exact additive diff:
 #define TEGU_PIPELINE2_WORD_TLS 17u  /* bytes per THREAD = Mesa pan_shader_info.tls_size; 0 none */
 #define TEGU_PIPELINE2_WORD_WLS 18u  /* bytes per WORKGROUP = pan_shader_info.wls_size (= nir shared_size); 0 none */
 #define TEGU_PIPELINE2_MAX_TLS 32768u   /* Valhall 16-bit signed TLS immediate */
 #define TEGU_PIPELINE2_MAX_WLS 32768u   /* Metal/Vulkan 32KiB threadgroup limit */
 struct tegu_pipeline_info2: replace 'uint32_t flags, reserved[3];' by 'uint32_t flags, tls_size, wls_size, reserved;' (size unchanged).
 parse2: replace 'w[17]||w[18]||' by 'w[17]>TEGU_PIPELINE2_MAX_TLS||w[18]>TEGU_PIPELINE2_MAX_WLS||' and set info.tls_size=w[17]; info.wls_size=w[18]. w[19..31] stay zero. Old parsers reject such packets (fail-safe); native must rebuild with the new header (root L4).
 I build the compiler with #ifdef TEGU_PIPELINE2_WORD_TLS: until your header lands the compiler keeps refusing (no packet emitted with nonzero words). Post 'TGP2 TLS/WLS header <sha>' and I rebuild under L2.
BRIDGE (nord2_metal_bridge.c, compute): today nord2_desc_local_storage(mem+192,0,0,0,0). For a pipeline with tls_size/wls_size, per dispatch allocate owned BOs retained to job completion and pack LOCAL_STORAGE exactly as pinned Mesa src/panfrost/lib/pan_desc.c GENX(pan_emit_tls) PAN_ARCH 9:
 TLS: tls_size field = pan_get_stack_shift(tls_size) (lib/pan_scratch.c); tls_address_mode = PACKED; tls_base_pointer = ptr>>8 with ptr 4096-aligned; BO bytes >= pan_get_total_stack_size(tls_size, threads_per_core, core_id_range) (pan_scratch.c; props from the GPU THREAD_FEATURES/core mask, same as panfrost/panvk).
 WLS: wls_base_pointer = ptr (4096-aligned, must not cross a 4GiB boundary), wls_size_scale = util_logbase2(pan_wls_adjust_size(wls_size))+1, wls_instances = pan_calc_wls_instances(&local, props, &grid) (lib/pan_desc.h); BO bytes >= pan_calc_total_wls_size(wls_size, wls_instances, core_id_range). wls_size==0 => wls_instances = MALI_LOCAL_STORAGE_NO_WORKGROUP_MEM (current behaviour).
 Keep COMPUTE_JOB allow_merging_workgroups = 0 (bridge already 0) — required with barriers/shared memory (Mesa valhall_can_merge_workgroups). Edge regions: each region package carries its own tls/wls words; use them per region. Metal setThreadgroupMemoryLength dynamic threadgroup arguments are NOT covered (static module size only) — refuse if AIR declares a threadgroup-length argument the planner cannot fold.
Reply ACK/corrections on board. Host-only; no hardware claim.
